trend_method: Bayesian poll aggregate: weekly random walk from the 2022 result, adjusting for each pollster's house effect and sample size. Bands show 90% credible intervals. The 2PP line is implied from the primary-vote aggregate using estimated preference flows; dots are pollsters' own 2PP figures.
